_about: Build 42 depth-map encoding, fitted by pzforge.depthmap.calibrate on vanilla tilesets: value = scale * depth + offset, depth = -(0.612*x + 0.5*y + 0.612*z) in metres (x east, y up, z south; nearer is smaller). Boxes from media/tileGeometry.txt were ray-cast at every third pixel of media/depthmaps/DEPTH_<tileset>.png. furniture_storage_02 (box-only geometry) fits to 1.6 units rms; the other two carry rotated boxes and polygons the box caster skips, hence their tails, but agree on the slope.
cross_check: DEPTH_whole_tile.png: 63 units per metre along x or z at floor level (= 103 * 0.612) and 0 at the tile's near corner at the cell's top (about 2.4 m); the far top corner reads 126 = 2 * 63.
